answer: Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The spiral graph is validated at intake and the bridge frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and wharf anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Forging one identity takes 11 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 309 takes that multiplied out, plus 205 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
